title: Actions are by intentions
cue: What the Prophet ﷺ said about intentions and emigration
arabic: عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَبِي حَفْصٍ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى. فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ».
translation:
It is narrated from the Commander of the Believers, Abu Hafs Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: “Actions are only by intentions, and every person will have only what he intended.

So whoever’s emigration was to Allah and His Messenger, his emigration is to Allah and His Messenger.

And whoever’s emigration was for something of this world he would gain, or a woman he would marry, his emigration is to what he emigrated for.”

witnesses.name: ibn-daqiq-sharh
witnesses.ref: Ibn Daqiq al-'Id, Sharh al-Arba'in, Mu'assasat al-Rayyan 2003, hadith 1, p. 24: https://shamela.ws/book/11244/14

provenance.note: Hashes are of each witness's text of this narration, from al-Nawawi's opening words to the end before his attribution line, with honorific formulas written as we print them (ﷺ, رضي الله عنه): see data-sources/hadith-arabic/SOURCE.md. All three witnesses agree with ours.

notes.text: Ibn Daqiq al-'Id relays, through al-Bayhaqi, that al-Shafi'i and Ahmad said this [[hadith]] takes in a third of knowledge: a person acts with the heart, the tongue and the limbs, and intention is the heart's share.

source.work: Ibn Daqiq al-'Id, Sharh al-Arba'in al-Nawawiyya
